laws.rule: Under the Shizuoka Mt Fuji Climbing Ordinance, climbers on the Fujinomiya, Gotemba and Subashiri trails must complete online rules training (FUJI NAVI app), pay JPY 4,000 per person per climb, and book a mountain hut to start between 2 pm and 3 am; there is no daily cap.

Atami City accommodation tax: JPY 200 a person a night (about A$1.80, RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82) at hotels, ryokan, simple lodgings and minpaku, collected by the lodging. Children under 12 and school-trip participants are exempt. The ministry's consent notice gives the start as 1 April 2025, for five years.

festivals.what: Hamamatsu Matsuri (Hamamatsu City): held over the Golden Week holidays, 3 to 5 May in 2026. By day, neighbourhood teams fly large kites in kite battles; at night, palace-style festival floats (goten yatai) are pulled through the city's streets. Dates for 2027 were not yet published when checked; the organising committee's site carries the schedule, venue map and access page.
